subsystems.name: Nanoscale chassis
subsystems.role: a particle small enough to move through tissue — typically tens to hundreds of nanometres across — that carries the working payload without being destroyed or cleared immediately.

subsystems.name: Propulsion and steering
subsystems.role: gets the particles to a chosen spot in skin or fat rather than relying on passive diffusion.
parts: external field coils or permanent-magnet arrays

subsystems.name: Targeting and sensing
subsystems.role: recognises the tissue to be changed and ignores everything else.

subsystems.name: Effector payload
subsystems.role: does the actual sculpting — dissolving fat, remodelling collagen or crosslinking tissue.

subsystems.name: Power and communication
subsystems.role: supplies energy and lets an operator confirm where the particles are and what they are doing.

subsystems.name: Clearance and safety
subsystems.role: removes the devices once the job is done and prevents an immune reaction.

buildSteps.title: Define the tissue target
buildSteps.detail: Decide exactly which cells in the dermis or subcutaneous fat must be removed, shrunk or re-tensioned, and how much.

buildSteps.title: Synthesise the particles
buildSteps.detail: Build the chassis by emulsion, nanoprecipitation or lithography, with tightly controlled size and shape.

buildSteps.title: Functionalise the surface
buildSteps.detail: Attach targeting molecules, stealth coatings and imaging labels so the particle goes only where intended.

buildSteps.title: Load the effector
buildSteps.detail: Enclose the enzyme, crosslinker or thermal actuator inside or on the surface, shielded until it is wanted.

buildSteps.title: Test on skin models
buildSteps.detail: Engineered skin and fat tissue cultures show whether the particles reach the right depth and act selectively.

buildSteps.title: Animal studies
buildSteps.detail: Small and then large animals establish dosing, steering accuracy, immune response and how the particles are cleared.

buildSteps.title: Human trials
buildSteps.detail: Safety first, in a small group with a medical indication, before any cosmetic use is considered.

buildSteps.title: Regulatory approval
buildSteps.detail: A programmable device that stays in the body needs a new kind of review — device, drug and software at once.

buildSteps.title: Clinical delivery
buildSteps.detail: Inject or apply the particles, steer them with an external field under imaging, activate the payload, then confirm clearance.

prerequisites.why: various nanoparticle systems are already used in medicine as drug carriers and imaging agents.

prerequisites.tech: Magnetically steered microrobots in living tissue
prerequisites.why: researchers have guided magnetic particles and small robots through animal blood vessels and eyes, but not through dense skin and fat at useful scale.
collagen-degrading enzymes are used clinically for other conditions, but precise, localised fat or collagen removal by enzyme is not established.
without real-time feedback, an operator cannot know where the particles are or how much tissue they have changed.
the body attacks and traps foreign particles; any that remain indefinitely are a long-term safety risk.

prerequisites.tech: On-board or wireless power at this scale
prerequisites.why: nanoscale devices cannot carry useful batteries, so energy must be delivered from outside the body.

pathway.milestone: laboratory and animal demonstrations of magnetically or acoustically steered micro- and nanoparticles
pathway.unlocks: proof that tiny devices can be moved to a chosen site inside tissue.

pathway.milestone: clinical trials of microrobots for targeted drug delivery in a specific organ
pathway.unlocks: a regulatory and manufacturing template for in-body active devices.

pathway.milestone: medical tissue-remodelling applications, such as treating scarring or localised fat disorders
pathway.unlocks: evidence of precise, safe tissue change without surgery.

pathway.milestone: if all of that works, a cosmetic procedure that reshapes skin and fat by injection and external control
pathway.unlocks: a non-surgical alternative to liposuction and lifting — still speculative, and may prove impractical at the required precision.
